component.name: DetailScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.cover = m.top.findNode("cover") m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.meta = m.top.findNode("meta") m.plot = m.top.findNode("plot") m.actions = m.top.findNode("actions") m.episodes = m.top.findNode("episodes") m.msg = m.top.findNode("msg") m.seasonBox = m.top.findNode("seasonBox") m.seasons = m.top.findNode("seasons") m.actions.observeField("itemSelected", "onAction") m.episodes.observeField("itemSelected", "onEpisode") m.seasons.observeField("itemSelected", "onSeasonPick") m.zone = "actions" m.epData = {} m.seasonNums = [] m.season = 0 m.hasEps = false m.target = invalid m.resumePos = 0 m.info = invalid end sub
sub refocus() if m.info <> invalid then buildActions() if m.zone = "episodes" m.episodes.setFocus(true) else if m.zone = "season" m.seasons.setFocus(true) else m.actions.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub onInfo() i = m.top.info m.info = i m.cover.uri = i.cover m.title.text = i.title m.plot.text = i.plot m.meta.text = "" if i.rating <> "" and i.rating <> "0" then m.meta.text = "Nota " + i.rating if i.kind = "movie" Fetch(Api("get_vod_info", "&vod_id=" + i.sid), "vod", "onVod") else m.msg.text = "Carregando episódios..." Fetch(Api("get_series_info", "&series_id=" + i.sid), "ser", "onSeries") end if buildActions() end sub
sub applyInfo(inf as Object) p = Sx(inf.plot) if p = "" then p = Sx(inf.description) if p <> "" then m.plot.text = p parts = [] r = Sx(inf.rating) if r <> "" and r <> "0" then parts.Push("Nota " + r) y = Sx(inf.releasedate) if Len(y) >= 4 then parts.Push(Left(y, 4)) du = Sx(inf.duration) if du <> "" then parts.Push(du) g = Sx(inf.genre) if g <> "" then parts.Push(g) if parts.Count() > 0 then m.meta.text = JoinStr(parts, " | ") img = Sx(inf.movie_image) if img = "" then img = Sx(inf.cover) if img <> "" then m.cover.uri = img end sub
sub onVod(event as Object) res = event.getData() if not res.ok then return d = res.data if type(d) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return if type(d.info) = "roAssociativeArray" then applyInfo(d.info) if type(d.movie_data) = "roAssociativeArray" e = Sx(d.movie_data.container_extension) if e <> "" then m.info.ext = e end if end sub
sub onSeries(event as Object) res = event.getData() m.msg.text = "" if not res.ok m.msg.text = "Não foi possível carregar os episódios." return end if d = res.data if type(d) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return if type(d.info) = "roAssociativeArray" then applyInfo(d.info) m.epData = {} m.seasonNums = [] eps = d.episodes if type(eps) = "roAssociativeArray" for each k in eps lst = eps[k] if type(lst) = "roArray" if lst.Count() > 0 m.epData[k] = lst m.seasonNums.Push(Int(Val(k))) end if end if end for end if m.seasonNums.Sort() if m.seasonNums.Count() = 0 m.msg.text = "Esta série não tem episódios disponíveis." return end if m.season = m.seasonNums[0] sp = FindSeriesProgress(m.info.sid) if sp <> invalid for each sn in m.seasonNums if sn = sp.season then m.season = sn end for end if m.hasEps = true fillEpisodes() buildActions() end sub
sub fillEpisodes() lst = m.epData[m.season.ToStr()] arr = [] if lst <> invalid n = lst.Count() if n > 300 then n = 300 for i = 0 to n - 1 e = lst[i] if type(e) = "roAssociativeArray" cv = "" if type(e.info) = "roAssociativeArray" then cv = Sx(e.info.movie_image) num = Sx(e.episode_num) if num = "" then num = (i + 1).ToStr() arr.Push({ title: "E" + num + " " + Sx(e.title), eptitle: Sx(e.title), epid: Sx(e.id), ext: Sx(e.container_extension), epnum: i + 1, cover: cv }) end if end for end if m.episodes.content = BuildNode(arr) m.episodes.visible = true end sub
function GetEp(season as Integer, epnum as Integer) as Dynamic lst = m.epData[season.ToStr()] if lst = invalid then return invalid if epnum < 1 or epnum > lst.Count() then return invalid e = lst[epnum - 1] cv = "" if type(e.info) = "roAssociativeArray" then cv = Sx(e.info.movie_image) return { season: season, epnum: epnum, epid: Sx(e.id), ext: Sx(e.container_extension), title: Sx(e.title), cover: cv, pos: 0 } end function
function NextEp(season as Integer, epnum as Integer) as Dynamic lst = m.epData[season.ToStr()] if lst <> invalid if epnum < lst.Count() then return GetEp(season, epnum + 1) end if for each sn in m.seasonNums if sn > season then return GetEp(sn, 1) end for return invalid end function
function SeriesPrimary() as String m.target = invalid sp = FindSeriesProgress(m.info.sid) if sp <> invalid if sp.done = true nx = NextEp(sp.season, sp.epnum) if nx <> invalid m.target = nx return "PRÓXIMO EPISÓDIO T" + nx.season.ToStr() + " E" + nx.epnum.ToStr() end if else ep = GetEp(sp.season, sp.epnum) if ep <> invalid ep.pos = sp.pos m.target = ep return "CONTINUAR T" + ep.season.ToStr() + " E" + ep.epnum.ToStr() + " " + FmtTime(sp.pos) end if end if end if ep = GetEp(m.seasonNums[0], 1) m.target = ep return "ASSISTIR T" + m.seasonNums[0].ToStr() + " E1" end function
sub buildActions() i = m.info items = [] prim = "ASSISTIR" m.resumePos = 0 if i.kind = "movie" p = LoadProgress() k = "m" + i.sid if p.DoesExist(k) if p[k].pos > 10 m.resumePos = p[k].pos prim = "CONTINUAR DE " + FmtTime(p[k].pos) end if end if else if m.seasonNums.Count() = 0 prim = "CARREGANDO..." else prim = SeriesPrimary() end if end if items.Push({ title: prim }) if i.kind = "series" and m.seasonNums.Count() > 1 items.Push({ title: "TEMPORADA: " + m.season.ToStr() }) end if m.actions.content = BuildNode(items) end sub
sub playEp(ep as Object) info = MakeInfo("ep", ep.epid, m.info.title + " - " + ep.title, ep.cover, ep.ext) info.series = m.info.sid info.season = ep.season info.epnum = ep.epnum info.key = "e" + ep.epid info.pos = ep.pos p = LoadProgress() if p.DoesExist(info.key) if p[info.key].done <> true then info.pos = p[info.key].pos end if m.top.play = info end sub
sub onAction() idx = m.actions.itemSelected i = m.info if idx = 0 if i.kind = "movie" info = MakeInfo("movie", i.sid, i.title, i.cover, i.ext) info.key = "m" + i.sid info.pos = m.resumePos m.top.play = info else if m.target <> invalid playEp(m.target) end if else openSeasons() end if end sub
sub onEpisode() c = m.episodes.content if c = invalid then return n = c.getChild(m.episodes.itemSelected) if n = invalid then return playEp({ season: m.season, epnum: n.epnum, epid: n.epid, ext: n.ext, title: n.eptitle, cover: n.cover, pos: 0 }) end sub
sub openSeasons() arr = [] for each sn in m.seasonNums arr.Push({ title: "Temporada " + sn.ToStr() }) end for m.seasons.content = BuildNode(arr) m.seasonBox.visible = true m.zone = "season" m.seasons.setFocus(true) end sub
sub closeSeasons() m.seasonBox.visible = false m.zone = "actions" m.actions.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onSeasonPick() idx = m.seasons.itemSelected if idx >= 0 and idx < m.seasonNums.Count() m.season = m.seasonNums[idx] fillEpisodes() buildActions() m.actions.jumpToItem = 1 end if closeSeasons() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if m.zone = "season" if key = "back" closeSeasons() return true end if return false end if if m.zone = "actions" if key = "right" and m.hasEps m.zone = "episodes" m.episodes.setFocus(true) return true end if else if m.zone = "episodes" if key = "left" or key = "back" m.zone = "actions" m.actions.setFocus(true) return true end if end if return false end function
